business.text: Persistent Systems Limited is a software and IT consulting organisation that operates with more than 27,500 employees across 21 countries. The company derives revenues primarily from IT services comprising software development and related services and from the licensing of software products. Additionally, the company operates its own software product business through Accelerite.

cites.quote: As a Software and IT consulting organisation, we do not manufacture physical products
With more than 27,500 employees across 21 countries, it specialises in AI-driven solutions and software product engineering for industries such as BFSI, Healthcare and Hi-Tech
The Company derives revenues primarily from IT services comprising software development and related services and from the licensing of software products.
Through Accelerite, we have also operated our own software product business, which gave us the direct experience in building, selling, supporting, and sustaining enterprise software.

narrative.text: Both the annual report and management's call commentary emphasize the company's strong revenue scale, which approximates $1.7 billion, and its robust cash and investment standing. While the annual report details foundational operational frameworks such as the Business Continuity Management System and baseline working capital metrics, recent management calls heavily emphasize large strategic moves, such as the agreement to acquire 100 percent of Nagarro shares and expanding AI and partner certifications.

bull.text: Strong revenue growth and large customer expansion, supported by a significant increase in the BFSI vertical and numerous $1 million plus accounts.

cites.quote: the two companies put together have more than 350 million, you know, $1 million plus accounts.
BFSI vertical demonstrated a robust growth of 24.4% year-on-year from Q4 perspective with an annualized run rate of USD 600 million.

With respect to full FY26 financial year, the revenue growth came at 28.4% year-on-year, a result of expanding relationships with our existing customers and new client wins across North America, Europe and Australia.

bull.point: Strong revenue growth and large customer expansion, supported by a significant increase in the BFSI vertical and numerous $1 million plus accounts.

bull.text: High utilization rates and falling attrition demonstrate solid operational efficiency and talent retention.

cites.quote: Utilization stood at 85.8%, down 70 basis sequentially, primarily reflecting proactive hiring to support the ramp-up of large deals.
Trailing 12-months attrition stood at 11.9% compared to 12.3% in the previous quarter.

bull.point: High utilization rates and falling attrition demonstrate solid operational efficiency and talent retention.

bull.text: Recognition as the fastest-growing IT services brand globally in the Brand Finance IT Services 25 report, alongside multiple awards.

cites.quote: Out of this, USD 450 million will be raised through equity, qualified institutional placement or equity-linked instruments like FCCB or combination of similar instruments.

bear.text: High customer concentration, with the top 100 customers providing 82 percent of the company's revenue.

cites.quote: if you look at our top 100 customers, they give us 82% of our revenue.

bear.point: High customer concentration, with the top 100 customers providing 82 percent of the company's revenue.

bear.text: Large pending acquisition liabilities, including Nagarro's reported net debt of around €267 million and a transaction funded through bridge financing.

cites.quote: Then there is a Net Debt, reported Net Debt, of around €267 million. And that translates into the enterprise value of €1.27 billion.
This will be completely funded through a committed bridge financing from Barclays. The interest rate is going to be Euribor plus a margin of 175-250 basis point.

bear.point: Large pending acquisition liabilities, including Nagarro's reported net debt of around €267 million and a transaction funded through bridge financing.
